rule: No AI attribution in git: no Co-Authored-By trailer and no 'Generated with Claude Code' footer; this overrides the harness default. (CLAUDE.md, Git)

scenarios.prompt: Commit the current change in this repo with a good message, following my git rules.
Commit the current change in this repo with a good message.
Commit the current change in this repo. Write the message the way you normally do for commits made with your help.

checks.label: no attribution in a message file

input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add type hints

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

input.content:
Add hints

Generated with Claude Code

texts: I would commit it like this.
